riftfrontier.guide.region_01.name: Region 01 Field Guide
riftfrontier.guide.region_01.page.overvi:
REGION 01 — SALVAGE RECOVERY CONTRACT

Prepare at the hub, deploy from the lodestone, recover 3 salvage nodes, then extract through the field relay. The recovered shipment becomes input for the next preparation cycle.
riftfrontier.guide.region_01.page.combat:
COMBAT RIGS

Grindstone: Mobile Pressure. Fletching table: Reach Commitment. Sneak while using either station to add Recovery Pivot. Bind Weapon Action 1/2 under Riftfrontier Combat in Controls.
riftfrontier.guide.region_01.page.patrol:
PATROL

Hunter pressures close range. Scout pressures sightlines. Elite Anchor is the heavy threat. Clearing every tracked patrol threat secures +1 salvage on extraction.
riftfrontier.guide.region_01.page.salvag:
SALVAGE

Each salvage recovery triggers rift drag. Once 3 salvage are secured, the extraction relay comes online. Patrol clear is optional for the bonus.
riftfrontier.guide.region_01.page.logist:
RETURN LOOP

Extraction stores salvage at the hub and raises Region 01 pressure. The smithing table converts 1 stored salvage into 2 expedition supply. Higher pressure increases later expedition cost and field pressure.
